description: MaxIOFS: S3 API, storage, security, background tasks and system, per node.

panels.title: Objects held
panels.description: Objects the selected nodes hold. With a replication factor above 1 each copy counts.

panels.title: Bytes held
panels.description: Bytes the selected nodes hold, versions included. With a replication factor above 1 each copy counts.

panels.title: S3 error ratio
panels.description: Share of S3 requests answered with HTTP 400 or above. Missing keys count.

panels.title: Errors by S3 code
panels.description: A HEAD error has no body and is shown by its HTTP status.

panels.title: Storage operations
panels.description: Operations on the storage backend. not_found is an object that is not there, not a failure.

panels.title: Storage latency p95
panels.description: A read's time is the time to open the object, not to read it.

panels.title: Object operations
panels.description: Object operations completed, from the S3 API, the console and background tasks.

panels.title: Object operation latency p95
panels.description: A read's time is the time to open the object, not to send it.

panels.title: Sign-ins
panels.description: S3 signatures, presigned URLs, browser form uploads and console sign-ins.

panels.title: Bucket changes
panels.description: Bucket creations, deletions and configuration changes, from the S3 API and the console.

panels.title: Retained objects
panels.description: Objects whose current version a retention mode holds, counted every 15 minutes.

panels.title: Task runs since start
panels.description: Runs of lifecycle, inventory, replication, stats, integrity, encryption, audit retention, STS sweep and cluster tasks since each node started.

panels.title: Events since start
panels.description: Disk, quota, node, integrity and account alerts, and configuration changes sent to the console since each node started.

panels.title: Metadata cache hit rate
panels.description: Pebble block cache, since each node started.

title: MaxIOFS
